prompt_fragment: This asset is a sprite. Keep the silhouette clean and readable, with one clear focal subject and strong separation from the background.
raw_description:
A High-Beak Auditor in full ceremonial warlord regalia, seen in a slight
3/4 overhead angle. Long ice-bladed sword held low, pale prismatic glyph
script hanging in the air around the free hand as he reads the ice-memory.
Black eye patch over one eye, a long scar across the beak. Posture of
command — mid-council and mid-campaign at once.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor plate on aged vellum cream parchment, a lean adult emperor penguin warlord in pale ice-plate armor and white ceremonial robes stands at slight overhead three-quarter angle, aurora-green prismatic light catching polished silver surfaces against deep slate shadow.

subjects.description: Tall adult emperor penguin, lean upright posture, scarred beak, black eye patch; pale ice-plate segmented armor over floor-length white robes, aurora-crystal coronet, rank glyphs inscribed in Chinese-influenced script across chest plate; long ice-bladed sword held low at right side, commanding downward gaze
subjects.position: centered, slight overhead three-quarter angle, full figure

subjects.description: Loose constellation of floating calligraphic glyph-script suspended around the raised free hand, painted as cool prismatic shimmer, each character faintly luminous at its ink edge, slow and meditative in arrangement
subjects.position: left foreground, orbiting the raised hand
